1.name: S1
1.hint: source of MOSFET 1 – the channel this entry models

2.name: D1/D2
2.hint: common drain of both MOSFETs, the same node as pin 5

3.name: S2
3.hint: source of MOSFET 2 – no role: kind nmos knows one channel, MOSFET 2 is neither simulated nor held to its limits

4.name: G2
4.hint: gate of MOSFET 2 – no role (see S2)

5.name: D1/D2
5.hint: common drain of both MOSFETs, the same node as pin 2

spice.model: .model FS8205A NMOS(LEVEL=1 VTO=0.7 KP=45.8 RD=0.0192 IS=3.5e-18)

hints: dual N-MOSFET with a common drain (pins 2 and 5): the entry models MOSFET 1 (S1, G1, D) only – in a cell-protection circuit the path through MOSFET 2 (S2, G2) is open in the simulation

compliance.source: LCSC product data C2830320 (2026-10-31): no RoHS statement (isRohsCert null); the data sheet states nothing

sources: TECH PUBLIC FS8205A data sheet (3 pages, no revision or date printed; scanned), via LCSC https://datasheet.lcsc.com/datasheet/pdf/c060cb7baa8cc2b2d2a0ed3afa443ef8.pdf?productCode=C2830320, read 2026-10-31 as images – TECH PUBLIC's document (logo and www.techpublic.com.tw on every page)

pins: p. 1 'package and pin configuration' shows the SOT-23-6 with the pin-1 dot at S1, the row S1, D1/D2, S2 and opposite G1, D1/D2, G2, but prints no pin numbers; the EasyEDA symbol of C2830320 (edakit part import 2026-10-31): 1 S1, 2 D1/D2, 3 S2, 4 G2, 5 D1/D2, 6 G1 – consistent with the dot and the usual counter-clockwise numbering
vds_max_v 20, vgs_max_v 10: p. 1 absolute maximum VDS 20 V, VGS ±10 V

id_max_a 4.8: p. 1 continuous drain current 6 A at TC = 25 °C, 4.8 A at TC = 70 °C (note 3, not printed) – the 70 °C value entered, conservative as in the siblings C15127 and C20917; pulsed 24 A; avalanche energy 7.4 mJ
p_max_w 1.5: p. 1 maximum power dissipation at TC = 25 °C; tj_max_c 150, t_min_c -55: p. 1 operating junction and storage temperature -55 … 150 °C
rth_ja_k_per_w 83: p. 1 thermal resistance junction to ambient, typ 83 °C/W (no maximum, no board stated); junction to case typ 14.4 °C/W
vgs_th_v 0.5 / 0.7 / 1.2 V (VDS = VGS, ID = 250 µA) and rds_on_max_ohm 25 / 31.5 mΩ at VGS 4.5 / 2.5 V, ID 3 A (typ 19.5 / 25 mΩ): p. 2 on characteristics; VSD ≤ 1.2 V at 6 A: p. 2

spice: assumption – level 1 fitted by Claude, no manufacturer model: VTO = VGS(th) typ; KP and RD chosen so that RDS(on) meets the maxima at 3 A (ngspice: 24.96 mΩ at 4.5 V, 31.46 mΩ at 2.5 V); IS so that the body diode drops 1.18 V at 6 A (max 1.2 V)

choice of the maker (2026-10-31): Fortune Semiconductor's FS8205A (C14212, C16052, TSSOP-8) has 0 pcs at LCSC; TECH PUBLIC's SOT-23-6 FS8205A has 139 300 pcs at LCSC and 139 306 at JLCPCB (Extended Part), FUXINSEMI's C908265 25 840 pcs; the Fortune and FUXINSEMI data sheets give other ratings (VGS ±12 V) – not used for this entry
notes: Dual N-MOSFET (common drain) for one-cell protection with the DW01A. Kind nmos describes one channel: MOSFET 1 carries the roles, MOSFET 2 is neither simulated nor checked (schema gap). Library draft, group power.

verified.datasheet: TECH PUBLIC FS8205A data sheet (3 pages, no revision or date printed; scanned)
checked: package drawing p. 1: pin-1 dot at S1; S1, D1/D2, S2 on one side, G1, D1/D2, G2 opposite – matches the EasyEDA symbol of C2830320 with counter-clockwise numbering
absolute maximum p. 1: VDS 20 V, VGS ±10 V, ID 6 / 4.8 A (TC 25 / 70 °C), PD 1.5 W, TJ -55 … 150 °C; RθJA typ 83 °C/W
electrical characteristics p. 2: VGS(th) 0.5 / 0.7 / 1.2 V; RDS(on) max 25 mΩ at 4.5 V and 31.5 mΩ at 2.5 V (3 A); VSD ≤ 1.2 V at 6 A
circuit diagram p. 1: two N-MOSFETs with body diodes, drains joined
open: pin numbers are not printed in the data sheet – taken from the EasyEDA symbol, consistent with the pin-1 dot of the drawing
a dual MOSFET does not fit kind nmos: MOSFET 2 (S2, G2) has no roles – not simulated and not held to VDS, VGS, ID (schema gap)
note 3 (the conditions of ID and RθJA) is referenced but not printed; RθJA is a typical value
no continuous body-diode current (is_body_max_a) and no VSD at 1 A (vsd_v_at_1a) – only VSD ≤ 1.2 V at 6 A
SPICE model is a level-1 fit by Claude, not a manufacturer model
RoHS: LCSC states nothing for C2830320
